newsitem.title: ITALY: Max rate 8.60 pct at Italy lira reverse repo.
newsitem.headline: Max rate 8.60 pct at Italy lira reverse repo.

text.p: The maximum rate at today's 9.0 trillion lire 10-day Bank of Italy reverse repurchase tender was 8.60 percent, compared with 8.59 percent previously, the Bank said.
The average rate was 8.56 percent against 8.54 percent at the last reverse repurchase pact for 10 trillion lire and 10 days on October 7.
The pact takes effect today and the securities are for repurchase on October 25. The Bank said it received 43 bids of which 23 were met in full and seven in part.
